title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
**Experience:** Minimum 2 years

**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India

**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Office-based

**Reporting To:** Project Manager

**Apply To:** hr@avanexa.com

**ABOUT AVANEXA TECHNOLOGIES**

Avanexa Technologies is a Guinness Record-holding, award-winning digital solutions company based in Coimbatore, with offices in Bengaluru, Australia, and the USA. For over 20 years, we have partnered with 1,500+ businesses globally — delivering web design & development, mobile application development, cloud & DevOps, digital marketing, UI/UX design, e-commerce platforms, marketplace listing, and outsourcing services. With an 87% repeat business rate and a portfolio spanning startups to enterprises, Avanexa is the growth partner businesses trust.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

Avanexa Technologies is looking for a skilled Mobile Application Developer with strong expertise in React Native, along with native development capabilities in Kotlin (Android) and Swift (iOS). The ideal candidate will be comfortable building cross-platform applications while also being able to dive into native code when performance or platform-specific features demand it.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop and maintain cross-platform mobile applications using React Native
* Build native modules or full native features in Kotlin and Swift when required
* Collaborate closely with designers and backend engineers to deliver polished product experiences
* Debug, test, and optimize app performance across devices and platforms
* Integrate REST APIs and third-party SDKs
* Participate in code reviews and follow good engineering practices, including clean architecture and Git-based version control

**ADDITIONAL DETAILS**

**Must-Have Skills**

* Solid React Native fundamentals, including hooks and state management
* Native Android development experience using Kotlin
* Native iOS development experience using Swift
* Experience publishing apps to the Google Play Store and Apple App Store
* Familiarity with REST APIs, Git, and basic CI/CD workflows
* Minimum 2 years of hands-on mobile development experience

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with TypeScript
* Exposure to backend or cloud services
* Experience with AI-integrated mobile features

**HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED**

* Compensation: To be determined by HR
* Notice Period: To be determined by HR

**WHY JOIN AVANEXA?**

* Work with a Guinness Record-holding company with 20+ years of legacy and a globally active client base across India, Australia, and the USA.
* Work with a full-stack service portfolio across web design, mobile apps, cloud & DevOps, UI/UX, and e-commerce platforms.
* Competitive compensation and growth-oriented work environment.
* Collaborative, high-energy team culture with direct access to leadership and fast decision-making.
* Clear career progression into Senior Developer and Engineering Lead roles as the team scales.
* Coimbatore headquarters with a growing regional footprint — be part of the core team that shapes the Western Tamil Nadu market.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your updated resume to hr@avanexa.com with the subject line:

“Mobile Application Developer – [Your Name] – [City]”

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within 5 working days for an initial screening call.

**For queries:** +919566381777 | www. avanexa.com/careers

Pay: ₹11,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
